verdict.rationale: The evidence shows CoreWeave offers managed Kubernetes (CKS) on bare-metal nodes with kubectl access. No item documents running a user-supplied Docker or container image, or a custom machine template or OS image. Node Pools are described only as sharing labels, taints and annotations, and container-image support is at most implied by Kubernetes, never documented.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run my own Docker image or custom machine template with my exact environment
